seo.title: What is a product catalogue?
seo.description: A product catalogue is the structured record of everything you sell: the products, their variants, their attributes and how they are grouped.

definition: A product catalogue is the structured record of everything you sell: the products, their variants, their attributes and how they are grouped.
answerBlock: A product catalogue is the structured record of everything you sell: the products, their variants, their attributes and how they are grouped. Its quality decides whether search, filtering and fitment lookups can work. A catalogue of photographs and free text cannot be filtered by anything.

body.heading: What makes a catalogue usable?
paragraphs: Attributes, consistently applied. If a buyer needs to filter by voltage, thread size or vehicle fitment, every record needs that field filled in the same units and the same vocabulary. Ninety per cent coverage produces a filter that hides the products it cannot classify.

Then relationships: which products are variants of one another, which are accessories, which replace a discontinued line. Those relationships are what turn a list into something a technician can navigate under time pressure.
Where the catalogue lives matters too. If the authoritative version is in an ERP or a product information system, the website should read from it rather than hold a second copy that drifts.

commercial.heading: Why does it matter commercially?
paragraphs: A searchable, filterable catalogue removes phone calls and wrong orders, and it produces pages that can rank for the specific terms buyers type, which a photograph-and-PDF catalogue never will.
Wrong-part returns are the visible cost of a bad one, and they are expensive in both freight and goodwill.

example.heading: What does it look like in practice?
example.body: Meridian Parts built fitment search across ninety thousand items so a technician finds the right part on a phone in a workshop, and wrong-part returns fell by 63%.
